in_hebrew.name: Tanney
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Gift from God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Tanney הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Tanys', meaning 'extended' or 'enduring'. In the Bible, Tanney could refer to the Tanais River, which was considered an extension of the Euphrates. Tanney is a spiritual name that symbolizes God's enduring presence and gift.
